description.value: A municipal recreation centre in Fort Nelson on the Alaska Highway, serving as the community hub for sports, fitness, and aquatic activities. Facilities include a 25-metre lane pool, a leisure pool, a climbing wall, and a dry pad for court sports. For touring cyclists on the remote Alaska Highway corridor, this is one of the few full-service recreation facilities for hundreds of kilometres.
